description: Runs Jobsite's deterministic OSHA 29 CFR 1904 decision tree on the facts of an injury or illness: returns the proposed 300-log classification (or the questions still needed), the rationale with verbatim 1904 quotes, and any report-to-OSHA deadline (8 or 24 hours). Map the story to the answers; leave out anything not known — unknowns come back as questions, never guesses. Reads and writes no records.

amputation_or_eye_loss.description: Amputation (incl. a fingertip) or loss of an eye.

days_away.description: ≥1 calendar day away after the day of injury (taken or recommended).

inpatient_hospitalization.description: Formal in-patient admission for care (not observation only).

new_case.description: A new case, not a recurrence of one already recorded.

restricted_or_transferred.description: Restricted work or job transfer beyond the day of injury.

significant_diagnosis.description: Cancer, chronic irreversible disease, fractured/cracked bone or punctured eardrum, diagnosed by a clinician.

treatments.description: Every care given ([] = none). First-aid items are the closed 1904.7(b)(5)(ii) list; anything else is medical treatment.

work_environment_event.description: An event or exposure at work caused or contributed.

name: osha_recordability_check
title: OSHA recordability check
